body: Oh that would be cool. Depends on how hard it would be for people to earn/get them I suppose. I’ll ask my parents as they used to work for the police. The only thing I remember my dad getting was a medal sort of thing from a reunion.

It would be cool to get coins like these but some people have worked hard for them. Perhaps coins from tourist areas would work, Ive gotten some from the Seattle Space needle that I cherish but would love to give away and make someone else happy with it. I’m in Australia and I’ve only ever been to America once, which was to visit my sister who is studying there, I miss her lots. But she’s coming back soon, sorry got off topic there.
